ios.desc:
Reclaim space on your iPhone by transforming Live Photos into high-quality still images.

The date and quality of the images are the same as before, but they take up less space.
The order of the images in your Photos app will be the same as before.

Live Photos are beautiful, but they take up more storage than a single still image. With LiveConvert, you can keep the moment you love while freeing up space for more memories.

Why choose LiveConvert?
	•	Simple & Fast - Convert in seconds with just one tap.
	•	Save Space - Keep the still frame, remove the motion.
	•	Batch Conversion - Select multiple Live Photos at once.
	•	Privacy-Friendly - No uploads. Everything stays on your device.
	•	Beautifully Designed - Clean, minimal interface inspired by Apple.

Perfect for:
	•	Users running low on storage.
	•	Photographers who want a sharper, single moment.
	•	Anyone looking to organize and simplify their photo library.

Free up storage. Keep the memories. Make your photo library lighter, faster, and more organized - with LiveConvert.

Note: The first 100 conversions are free, then an upgrade to Premium is required.
